column1: # note: our arm REBUILT: /mnt/linuxdisk/home/juanfraitu/rustle_target/release/copy_assign --bam /mnt/linuxdisk/home/juanfraitu/bakeoff/human/hsa16.bam --fasta /mnt/linuxdisk/home/juanfraitu/winloci_data/chm13v2.0.fa --region chr16:11963320-80438591 --families /mnt/linuxdisk/home/juanfraitu/bakeoff/human/copies16.tsv --copies-fa /mnt/linuxdisk/home/juanfraitu/bakeoff/human/copies16.fa --gtf --origin-drop-indels --threads 4 --out /mnt/linuxdisk/tmp/rustle_figures/fig5/hard_locus/current/rustle_arm/ours (one process writes ours.gtf and ours.assignments.tsv; log /mnt/linuxdisk/tmp/rustle_figures/fig5/hard_locus/current/rustle_arm/ours.log)

# note: settings that differ from the recorded run (ours_final_gtf.params.tsv): best_by_duel absent -> true; gtf_copy_set absent -> true; min_isoform_fraction absent -> 0; min_boundary_fraction absent -> 0.1; min_boundary_gap absent -> 5000
# note: outcome counts that differ from the recorded run: origin_rejected 1232 -> 1257; readthrough_explained 1 -> 0

# note: default change not recorded in params.tsv: RUSTLE_JUNCTION_MAJORITY: the --gtf assembly's junction gate tolerates a minority of non-canonical junctions by default since 2026-09-21 (e44170f2); the recorded GTFs were built with strict canonical junctions
# note: swept region chr16:11963320-80438591 = the catalog span, the same region the recorded runs swept

# note: hard-locus benchmark (PREREG_hard_locus_bakeoff_2026-09-09): human A119b reads (hsa16.bam = samtools view -b -M -L copyregions.bed A119b.t2t.bam, command in its @PG header), chr16 NPIP family (copies16.tsv, 26 copies)

# note: the hard set is a Rustle product: the rows of OUR copy_assign run's assignments.tsv (molecules its AS-tied gate admits: >= 2 placements in the swept region with the runner-up AS equal to the best, one in a catalog copy) that also have a primary inside a copy (the scored universe: primaries -F 2308 in the merged copy intervals, identical for every tool); no scorer option defines it from the BAM alone; the strata (contested, tied, assigned, ...) are our certificate's own verdicts

# note: fraction_carried = derived_one|derived_multi (the tool emits a transcript with the molecule's exact intron chain that overlaps a catalog copy, copy = max raw overlap; for a mono-exonic molecule the exact chain means span containment); fuzz 0 for rustle/stringtie/flair, 5 for isoseq (pre-registered)

# note: chain_ge2_molecules = --min-mult 2 --bam: the support-matched control, POST HOC (PREREG_hard_locus_bakeoff_2026-09-09 section 'Why P5 fails: a support policy, not resolution (post-hoc control, labelled as such)'; the pre-registered support-matched table of PREREG_isoform_bakeoff is for the retired lift-aware metric)
# note: the Rustle arm is copy_assign --families --gtf (copy_assign's own transcripts), not the assembler (tools/rustle_pipeline.sh assemble) of Figures 1-3
# note: the 0.846 / 0.574 / 0.502 / 0.755 composite quoted in older notes is bench/isoform_bakeoff.py --summary (retired, 3,633 molecules) and is NOT what this table reports
